 Hon'Ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha, J. 
1.
The matter is taken up on mentioning.

2. Heard Ms. Shaheen Bano, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Vikash Kumar Shukla, learned counsel holding brief of Sri Shahnawaz Khan, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and Sri B.P. Singh, learned AGA for the State.

3. Instant application has been preferred for quashing of impugned charge sheet dated 22.12.2020 along with cognizance/summoning order dated 6.7.2023 in entire criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1572 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 333 of 2020 under sections 420, 406, 504 IPC,
P.S. Kayamganj, District Farrukhabad pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate Kayamganj, Farrukhabad in the terms of compromise entered between the parties.
It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.

4. It is contended by learned counsel for the applicants that both the parties have amicably settled all the disputes and they have agreed for withdrawal of all cases, including present case, pending between the parties and the same has been verified by the court concerned.
A report regarding the same is available on record.

It is further submitted that in view of these facts and circumstances, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the impugned proceedings pending and thus, the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
5.
Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 have no objection.
6. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

7. Both the parties have amicably settled all the disputes and they have agreed for withdrawal of all cases, including present case, pending between the parties and the same has been verified by the court concerned.
A report regarding the same is available on record.

Considering the law laid down in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296 and the facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed.

sentences.text: 8. In view of the aforesaid, the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 1572 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 333 of 2020 under sections 420, 406, 504 IPC, P.S. Kayamganj, District Farrukhabad pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate Kayamganj, Farrukhabad, against applicants, are hereby quashed.
9. The application is allowed.
